_comment: Skill-level shared defaults for zerowall-literature. These apply to ALL tasks unless overridden by <task>/analysis/verified_data.json. Add entries here only when a JIF or author fact is correct across all tasks. For task-specific corrections, create <task>/analysis/verified_data.json instead — that file wins on conflict.

_meta.description: Shared cross-task verified data. Empty by default — task-specific files take precedence.
_meta.jif_note: Values are JCR JIF (not CiteScore/SJR/OpenAlex). Format: [value, year_string, source_url]
